duster.headline: No 2020+ diesel auto under R220k; criteria-fit pick is 2022 TechRoad Auto R249 900 (+R12 185, 47 051 km); biggest bargain 2022 Zen is manual.

shortlist.note: 2022 TechRoad Auto diesel, R249 900, 47 051 km, +R12 185 — only listing meeting auto+2020+diesel.
2022 Zen diesel, R209 990, 72 000 km, +R24 273 — biggest discount, but manual.
Cheapest diesel auto: 2019 Dynamique, R195 000, 88 500 km, +R5 717; pre-facelift, small dealer.

alerts: Criteria floor for a 2020+ diesel auto is R249 900 (28741951); everything cheaper is manual or 2019.

caddy.headline: Thin market: single Crew Bus at R279 990/76 000 km fits both caps; no alternatives — verify history at CBK before committing.

shortlist.note: Only option: 2020 1.6 Crew Bus, R279 990, 76 000 km — R20k under cap; verify service history.

alerts: Sole listing under caps — no comparables to benchmark; treat R279 990 as negotiable.

jimny.headline: All three are 3-door (no 5-door present); 2018 1.3 at R234 890/86 000 km is cheapest, new-gen GLX from R289 890.

shortlist.note: Cheapest: 2018 1.3, R234 890, 86 000 km — old-gen but robust; R55k below new-gen entry.
2020 1.5 GLX AllGrip, R289 890, 78 000 km — new-gen value under both caps.
2021 GLX AllGrip, R295 995, 25 115 km — lowest km but no dealer listed; verify seller.

seltos.headline: Standout: 2021 EX Auto R210 000 (+R37 692) at 100 000 km; multi-franchise Durban Kia lists 2022 EX+ Auto R234 900 (+R13 700) — good for the Duster trade.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.6 EX Auto, R210 000, 100 000 km, +R37 692 — biggest auto bargain; six-figure km.
2022 1.6 EX+ Auto, R234 900, 97 876 km, +R13 700; Durban Multifranchise — best trade-in fit.
2023 1.6 EX Auto, R274 990, 44 000 km, +R26 946 — low-km newer alternative.

alerts: Manual 2021 EX at R189 900 (+R44 930) is the market's biggest discount but fails the automatic criterion.

creta.headline: 2024 Premium Auto R279 999 (+R26 362, 40 000 km) leads; diesel-auto pick 2021 1.5D Executive R269 990/60 099 km is fairly priced.

shortlist.note: 2024 1.5 Premium Auto, R279 999, 40 000 km, +R26 362 — newest, big discount; independent dealer, verify.
2021 1.5D Executive Auto diesel, R269 990, 60 099 km, +R426 — gen2 diesel auto at fair money.
2021 1.5 Premium, R199 990, 81 000 km, +R33 653 — biggest discount but manual, seller unlisted.

alerts: 28479041 '2021 1.6D Executive' is gen1-era 1.6 diesel (400 L boot), 98 000 km — confirm generation before viewing.

hr-v.headline: Both listings are old-gen with 448 L boot + Magic Seats; 2021 Comfort CVT R249 990/57 000 km undercuts the 1.8 Elegance by R49k.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.5 Comfort CVT, R249 990, 57 000 km — old-gen 448 L boot + Magic Seats.
2020 1.8 Elegance Auto, R298 900, 50 000 km — more power, R49k dearer, same old-gen boot.

corolla-cross.headline: Baseline: 14 units, R249 990–R299 990, no hybrids (as expected); 2021 XS R249 990/36 300 km (+R20 200) sets the value benchmark.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.8 XS, R249 990, 36 300 km, +R20 200 — cheapest, full XS spec.
2024 1.8 Xi, R259 990, 22 294 km, +R14 156 — near-new but base spec.

discovery.headline: Only MG ZS (443 L) clears the 430 L bar; Omoda C5 qualifies only via 2025+ X Series (442 L); rest fail or unverified.

shortlist.note: 443 L clears bar outright; all 6 listings autos, within budget — top add.
Only 2025+ X Series trims hit 442 L; standard C5 is 378 L — conditional watch on X Series.
